|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ドッキング・ベイ内の管制ガントリーに配属された士官。磁気フィールドの開閉、空気の安定供給、保安体制の維持などを担当する。ラルティアの作戦以来、反乱軍スパイの侵入に対して神経質になった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Lt. Pol Treidum.

'''Card text:'''
While at Docking Control Room 327, add 2 to your total power at Docking Bay 327. Once during each of your control phases, if at the same location as an undercover spy, you may draw destiny. If destiny equals the spy's ability, the spy "reveals their true identity."

'''Lore:'''
An officer assigned to the control gantry inside the docking bay. He handles magnetic field operation, stable air supply, and security. Since the Ralltiir operation, he has become nervous about Rebel spy infiltration.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title prints the rank as the suffix 中尉.
